placeholder.name: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Temporary text that occupies the select when it is empty.

isOpen.name: Open
isOpen.description: Whether the select listbox is open (controlled).

defaultOpen.name: Default Open
defaultOpen.description: Whether the select listbox is open by default (uncontrolled).

autoComplete.name: Auto Complete
autoComplete.description: Describes the type of autocomplete functionality the browser should provide.

autoFocus.name: Auto Focus
autoFocus.description: Whether the select should be focused on mount.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name of the select, used when submitting an HTML form.
